summary: The root ورق (waraqa) primarily refers to leaves. A "waraq" is a leaf, and "waraqa" can describe a tree with abundant leaves, or one that is leafy and provides ample shade.
lane: شَجَرٌ وَارِقٌ ذ Trees having leaves: (Msb:) [or leafy trees; trees having many leaves; for] شَجَرَةٌ وَارِقَةٌ (TA) and and (S, K, TA) signify a tree having many leaves. (S, K, TA.) And شَجَرَةٌ وَارِقَةُ الظِّلَالِ [ A tree having leafy coverings or shades ]. (K in art. غيل .)
